HELP US UNDERSTAND YOUR GOALS

A few details make a useful enquiry.

01

For your own development

Tell us your role, the standard that interests you and whether you want to build awareness, implementation knowledge or audit skills.

02

For your organisation

Include your team size, participant responsibilities and locations, relevant time zones and preferred start period.

03

Before enrolling

Ask about the current fees, course prerequisites, learning format, access period and examination arrangements.

HOW TO SEND

Prepare. Review.
Send your enquiry.

  1. Complete the form. Add your contact details and training goals.
  2. Select Submit Enquiry. Your details are prepared as an email draft.
  3. Review and send. Open the draft in your email app or copy the text into an email to Think Risk.

WEBSITE PRIVACY

Your enquiry details

The enquiry form prepares an email draft in your browser. This website does not submit or store the information you enter on a server.

When you send the draft, the details go to Think Risk International at pecb@thinkrisk.com.au through your email provider. Include only information needed for your training enquiry.

Your selected pricing currency may be remembered in this browser. Contact pecb@thinkrisk.com.au for questions about how Think Risk handles information received by email.
